name: Kid's Roxy Jetty Girl Jacket Girls' 2016 - XL Pink
description: evo.com | Roxy Jackets > Christmas is any day when you can get your little lady the Roxy Jetty Girl Jacket. When the snow begins to fall, she'll beg you to take her up to the mountain so she can show off this Roxy Dry Flight waterproof, insulated jacket. Available in bright, energetic colors, the Jetty Girl comes with an internal goggle pocket and sleeve pass pocket so she can stow her ticket to ride. Fixed Hood Engineered embossed taffeta and brushed tricot 10K ROXY Dry Flight Technology Water resistant rate of 10000 mm and a moisture management rate of 10000 gr / sqm / 24h. ROXY Dry Flight technologies are engineered to keep you warm, dry and protected without overheating. Regular Fit Roxy's collection-wide keystone fit for many years, their Regular Fit is equal parts flattering and comfortable. Offering plenty of room for layering and mobility. Body 200g
